verdict.rationale: Docs confirm free Docker self-hosting (anythingllm-docs-8) and community reports confirm the desktop installer is a quick 'single install' that got users running in under 5 minutes (anythingllm-comm-1, anythingllm-comm-5). However, hands-on reports also show real friction: a Linux install requiring a manual chmod/chown fix for chrome-sandbox (anythingllm-comm-7) and a Docker pull failure (anythingllm-comm-8), meaning the 'one command to working chat' promise isn't always frictionless. Missing for 10: a documented official one-line install script/npm-pip package with reproducible success, and resolution of the reported install/docker friction.
